1. 고칼슘혈증이 있거나 의약품 복용 시 전문가와 상담하십시오.

Health Functional FoodNiacin 4.5mgManganese 1.04mgVitamin A 329μgVitamin B1 0.45mgVitamin B12 1.4μgVitamin B2 0.588mgVitamin B6 0.525mgVitamin C 45mgVitamin D 4μgVitamin E 6mgZinc 4.44mgFolate 212.5μgOnce a day

온가족 종합비타민&미네랄Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate

Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주) · Once a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 4.5mg of Niacin, 1.04mg of Manganese, 329μg of Vitamin A, 0.45mg of Vitamin B1, 1.4μg of Vitamin B12, 0.588mg of Vitamin B2, 0.525mg of Vitamin B6, 45mg of Vitamin C, 4μg of Vitamin D, 6mg of Vitamin E, 4.44mg of Zinc, 212.5μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • Once a day (1 tablet): 4.5mg Niacin, 1.04mg Manganese, 329μg Vitamin A, 0.45mg Vitamin B1, 1.4μg Vitamin B12, 0.588mg Vitamin B2, 0.525mg Vitamin B6, 45mg Vitamin C, 4μg Vitamin D, 6mg Vitamin E, 4.44mg Zinc, 212.5μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by 코스맥스엔비티(주)

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 tablet per servingChew to take

Labelled standard

Niacin labelled (4.5mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Manganese labelled (1.04mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin A labelled (329μg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin B1 labelled (0.45mg / 1500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B12 labelled (1.4μg / 1500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B2 labelled (0.588mg / 1500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin B6 labelled (0.525mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin C labelled (45mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Vitamin D labelled (4μg / 1500mg), 80~180%
Vitamin E labelled (6mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Zinc labelled (4.44mg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Folate labelled (212.5μg / 1500mg), 80~150%
Appearance 고유의 향미가 있고 이미, 이취가 없는 흰 노랑색의 원형 츄어블 정제
Coliform Negative
Shelf life 제조일로부터 24개월까지
Storage ① 직사광선을 피해 서늘한 곳에 보관하시고, 어린이의 손이 닿지 않는 곳에 보관하십시오. ② 제품 개봉 후에는 흡습이 일어날 수 있으니 반드시 밀봉하여 보관하십시오.

Who it suits

  • Those who want to take Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate together daily
  • Those who prefer this form
  • Those who want a convenient way to manage multiple nutrients
Precautions · Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult a professional before use · Consult a professional if you have hypercalcaemia or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur · Keep out of reach of children · Refer to the official cautions printed on the product

멀티비타민Niacin · Manganese · Vitamin A · Vitamin B1 · Vitamin B12 · Vitamin B2 · Vitamin B6 · Vitamin C · Vitamin D · Vitamin E · Zinc · Folate

Made by (주)원일바이오 · 2 times a day · 1 tablet

This product combines 63.51mg of Niacin, 2.21mg of Manganese, 325μg of Vitamin A, 5.26mg of Vitamin B1, 1.04μg of Vitamin B12, 6.37mg of Vitamin B2, 2.1mg of Vitamin B6, 643mg of Vitamin C, 5.72μg of Vitamin D, 5.91mg of Vitamin E, 6.2mg of Zinc, 254μg of Folate as labelled amounts. The officially recognised functions of each are listed below.

Why this product

  • 2 times a day (1 tablet): 63.51mg Niacin, 2.21mg Manganese, 325μg Vitamin A, 5.26mg Vitamin B1, 1.04μg Vitamin B12, 6.37mg Vitamin B2, 2.1mg Vitamin B6, 643mg Vitamin C, 5.72μg Vitamin D, 5.91mg Vitamin E, 6.2mg Zinc, 254μg Folate
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard
  • Made by (주)원일바이오

Officially recognised functions by ingredient

  • Niacin
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Manganese
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
    • Needed for bone formation
    • Needed for energy utilisation
  • Vitamin A
    • Needed for the adaptation of vision in dim light
    • Needed to form and maintain skin and mucous membranes
    • Needed for the growth and development of epithelial cells
  • Vitamin B1
    • Needed for carbohydrate and energy metabolism
  • Vitamin B12
    • Needed for normal folate metabolism
  • Vitamin B2
    • Needed for energy production in the body
  • Vitamin B6
    • Needed for protein and amino acid utilisation
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
  • Vitamin C
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Vitamin D
    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus
    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of bone
    • Recognised as helping reduce the risk of developing osteoporosis
  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

2 times a day1 tablet per servingWith water

    • Needed for the formation and maintenance of connective tissue
    • Needed for the absorption of iron
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)

    • Needed for the absorption and utilisation of calcium and phosphorus

  • Vitamin E
    • Needed to protect cells from harmful oxygen (free radicals)
  • Zinc
    • Needed for normal immune function
    • Needed for normal cell division
  • Folate
    • Needed to help maintain normal blood homocysteine levels
    • Needed for cell and blood formation
    • Needed for the normal development of the fetal neural tube
